cases.requested_action: bounded job that requires a human approval; the approver does not answer (approval_unavailable) or approves (approval_reachable control)
cases.protected_target: Proofable job dispatch (approval hold before executor assignment)

authority_evidence.source: current Proofable authority state evaluated at dispatch
authority_evidence.check_at_dispatch: controller→agent delegation resolved; the job requires approval, so the signed decision is STEP_UP and no executor is assigned

dispatch_decision.reason: approval required; held until the approver decides

delegation_and_fallback.decision_deadline_source: JOB_APPROVAL_EXPIRY_MS in the deployed protocol revision; an unanswered approval fails the job when the window ends
delegation_and_fallback.pre_authorized_fallback: not_applicable: the deployed path has no fallback authority; an unanswered approval never widens what the grant allows

observed_effect.evidence: the held job was never assigned an executor; terminal status cancelled

limitations: The hold was ended by the owner cancelling the job, standing in for an approver who never answers; the 24-hour approval window was not waited out in this run.
No pre-authorized fallback exists on this path, so the fallback variant of case 4 is not applicable rather than passed.

In the approved control, the signed terminal statement's evaluation block reads approval.required false although the signed authority decision was STEP_UP and the job was observed waiting for approval; the authority decision and the observed hold are the evidence for the approval step. Corrected in the service source after this run (evaluation record version 2 reads the persisted hold and its decision; protocol commit 44d179a84); the deployed revision of this run predates the fix.
